name: El Retail Moderno: Gestión de Cadena de Retail
description: Three-round simulation where students act as the executive committee of Maravillas del Hogar S.A.C., a Peruvian home improvement retail chain struggling with high working capital, inventory bloat, and competitive pressure from Ferrandina and Casalto. Participants optimize assortment, implement dynamic pricing, and decide on digital transformation and store expansion strategies.
